title: Molly and the Path with No Wheels
synopsis: Molly catches a missing link in Jack's walking-path drawing. The friends trace the green gate, the bridge, and brook, adding a more faithful foot route before meeting Mr. Lee.
continuity_state: Before: Jack has a rough two-line map from the toy-town experiment, but its drawn walking path omits the short segment from the Little Bridge landing to the farm's green gate. After: Molly helps correct the missing footpath segment, Jack adds the winding brook in blue and the green gate, and Mr. Lee agrees to consider a permanent picture board. The original bridge, farm and barn-side shelter are unchanged.
